Blank level uses parent-handle Add dialog; accepted object returns its decimal Address. Nonblank remains exact-address create-enabled getter.

boundaries.transport_name_bound: Accepted SceneManager names: 1..128 trimmed characters; no ASCII controls/DEL, invalid UTF-8 surrogates, U+FFFE/U+FFFF, literal #, repeated internal spaces or non-ASCII whitespace. These are explicit software transport bounds, not original dialog refusal equivalence.
